content.title: How to Watch Coachella 2026 Live: Dates, Set Times, Streaming, and How to Buy Merch
content.text: Coachella 2026 set times are officially out, and even if you're not heading to the desert, there are plenty of ways to tune in from home.The festival's livestream experience is expanding again this year, offering more stages, interactive features, and flexible viewing options so you can catch your favorite artists without missing a beat.You can watch performances via the official Coachella YouTube channel.The livestream runs across both festival weekends, April 10 to 12 and April 17 to 19, giving you access to multiple performances in real time across the festival’s seven stages.One of the biggest features is multiview, which allows you to watch up to four stages at the same time in multiview mode from your TV. While in multiview mode, you can switch audio between feeds so you can follow overlapping sets more easily.You can also use the Coachella livestream app, which is designed to make planning and watching easier. It lets you view the full livestream and replay schedule—synced to your time zone—so you know exactly when to tune in. You can use it to personalize your livestream schedule, set reminders, watch highlights on-demand, and more.The lineup includes major global names across both weekends, though it’s important to note this list reflects poster highlights and not every artist is guaranteed to be livestreamed.Friday, April 10 and April 17 includes Sabrina Carpenter, Disclosure, Teddy Swims, KATSEYE, Sexyy Red, Central Cee, and Foster the People.Saturday, April 11 and April 18 features Justin Bieber, The Strokes, Given, Addison Rae, Labrinth, SOMBR, Swae Lee, Taemin, PinkPantheress, Davido, and BIA.Sunday, April 12 and April 19 closes out the festival with KAROL G, Young Thug, BIGBANG, Major Lazer, FKA twigs, and CLIPSE.Even though the set times are now available, livestream coverage is selective. The listed artists are pulled from the official poster and are not a guarantee of broadcast.A separate schedule for the YouTube broadcast will be made available on Coachella’s official website ahead of each festival day.Fans can get their hands on exclusive festival and artist merchandise at Complex.com
